name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
description: Tommy Vercetti fights his way to the top of a neon-soaked, 1980s Miami-inspired crime empire, set to one of the best soundtracks in gaming.

name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
description: CJ returns home to Grove Street after his mother's murder and is pulled back into gang life across an early-'90s state spanning three cities, countryside and desert.

name: Grand Theft Auto IV
description: Niko Bellic arrives in Liberty City chasing the American Dream and a past he can't outrun, in the series' grittiest, most grounded story.

name: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Three very different criminals, Michael, Franklin and Trevor, pull off a string of heists across Los Santos and Blaine County.

name: Grand Theft Auto VI
description: Lucia and Jason, a criminal duo, are caught up in a conspiracy across the state of Leonida after a simple job goes wrong. The series returns to Vice City.

name: PUBG: Battlegrounds
description: 100 players parachute onto an island, scavenge for gear and fight to be the last one standing as the play zone shrinks.

name: Counter-Strike 1.6
description: Terrorists versus Counter-Terrorists in tight, round-based firefights. The LAN-café classic that defined competitive shooters.

name: Counter-Strike 2
description: The Source 2 rebuild of Counter-Strike, with reworked maps, responsive smoke grenades and sub-tick servers.

name: Rocket League
description: Football, but with rocket-powered cars. Easy to pick up, and the aerial mechanics take years to master.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Arthur Morgan rides with the Van der Linde gang as the outlaw era dies around them, in a vast and patient portrait of 1899 America.

name: Cities: Skylines
description: Build a city from a single road: zone it, power it, untangle its traffic and keep the citizens happy as it grows into a metropolis.

name: Need for Speed: Underground
description: Night-time street racing and deep tuning culture, with neon underglow, body kits and Nu-metal blaring through rain-slick city streets.

name: Need for Speed: Underground 2
description: The underground scene goes open-world in Bayview, with even deeper customisation and SUVs joining the street races.

name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted
description: Climb Rockport's Blacklist to win back your BMW M3 GTR, while relentless police pursuits escalate all the way to helicopters and roadblocks.

name: Need for Speed: Carbon
description: Return to Palmont City to take its districts from rival crews, settling each one with a duel down a twisting canyon road.

name: Need for Speed Payback
description: Tyler, Mac and Jess take on the cartel that rigs every race in Fortune Valley, through heists, high-speed chases and off-road events.

name: Freedom Fighters
description: In an alternate history where the Soviet Union has invaded New York, plumber Chris Stone leads a growing squad of resistance fighters to take the city back.

name: Call of Duty 2
description: Second World War campaigns as Soviet, British and American soldiers, from the defence of Moscow to the cliffs of Pointe du Hoc.

name: Virtua Cop 2
description: An on-rails light-gun shooter: the Virtua City Police chase EVL Inc. through car chases, a cruise ship and a subway, and you must spare the civilians.

name: The House of the Dead
description: Agents Thomas Rogan and G storm Dr. Curien's mansion in a light-gun shooter full of zombies, branching paths and hostages to save.

name: The House of the Dead 2
description: Agents James Taylor and Gary Stewart fight through a zombie-overrun Venice, gloriously cheesy voice acting and all.

name: Project I.G.I.
description: Ex-SAS operative David Jones infiltrates sprawling military bases across Eastern Europe to recover a stolen nuclear warhead.

name: Sleeping Dogs
description: Undercover cop Wei Shen infiltrates the Sun On Yee triad in Hong Kong, with brutal martial-arts brawls and loyalties pulled in both directions.

name: Watch Dogs 2
description: Hacker Marcus Holloway and DedSec take on a city-wide surveillance system across a sunny, satirical San Francisco Bay Area.

name: Just Cause 3
description: Rico Rodriguez returns to his Mediterranean homeland of Medici to topple a dictator, with a grappling hook, a wingsuit and an absurd amount of explosives.

name: Need for Speed Rivals
description: Racers and cops chase each other across Redview County, playing either side and putting their speed points at risk in every pursuit.

name: Horizon Zero Dawn
description: Outcast hunter Aloy explores a post-apocalyptic world ruled by animal-like machines, uncovering what ended the old civilisation.

name: House Flipper
description: Buy run-down houses, then clean, repair and redecorate them room by room before selling them on for a profit.

name: Mini Metro
description: Draw subway lines for a growing city and keep passengers moving as new stations appear and the network strains to keep up.

name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
description: Move to a deserted island and slowly turn it into a home, one fish, fossil, furniture piece and animal neighbour at a time.

name: GRID
description: Circuit racing in touring cars, muscle cars and hypercars, where rival drivers remember who rammed them and race you harder for it.

name: Saints Row: The Third
description: The Third Street Saints, now celebrity gangsters, are thrown into the city of Steelport and take it over with absurd weapons, tanks and zero restraint.

name: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne
description: A film-noir love story told in graphic-novel panels: NYPD detective Max Payne is drawn back to Mona Sax, with bullet time and ragdoll physics in every shootout.

name: Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition
description: Remastered versions of GTA III, Vice City and San Andreas, with updated lighting, modern controls and GTA V-style weapon wheels.

name: Far Cry 4
description: Ajay Ghale returns to the Himalayan nation of Kyrat to scatter his mother's ashes and is caught in a civil war against the flamboyant dictator Pagan Min.

name: Cricket 07
description: Full international cricket with licensed teams, the Ashes and the World Cup, and the go-to game for modding in updated squads for years afterwards.

name: FIFA 15
description: Club and international football with a new emotional-intelligence system for players, physical goalkeepers and the ever-addictive Ultimate Team.

name: Duck Hunt
description: Point the NES Zapper light gun at the TV and shoot ducks out of the sky, while the dog laughs at every miss.

name: Woody Woodpecker Racing
description: A cartoon kart racer starring Woody Woodpecker and friends, with power-ups, shortcuts and tracks themed on their animated world.

name: Autobahn Raser II
description: Flat-out racing through traffic on real stretches of the German Autobahn, with the police never far behind.

name: Need for Speed II
description: Exotic supercars like the McLaren F1 and Ferrari F50 racing point-to-point across scenic tracks around the world.

name: Pepsiman
description: The Pepsi mascot sprints, slides and skateboards through obstacle-packed stages to deliver cans to thirsty people, between live-action ads of a man drinking Pepsi.

name: Gran Turismo 2
description: The real driving simulator on PlayStation: licence tests, rally events and a garage of over 600 cars to buy, tune and race.

name: Battlefield 4
description: Large-scale combined-arms warfare across land, sea and air, where skyscrapers and dams can be brought down mid-match.

name: Twisted Metal 2
description: Vehicular combat in arenas around the world, from Los Angeles to Paris, as Calypso's contest rewards the last driver standing with any wish they want.

name: Spider-Man
description: Web-swinging across New York rooftops to clear Peter Parker's name, facing Venom, Scorpion, Mysterio and Doc Ock, with Stan Lee narrating.

name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted
description: Criterion's open-world reboot: find cars parked around Fairhaven, take on the city's ten Most Wanted racers and outrun relentless police.

name: Need for Speed: The Run
description: Jack Rourke races coast to coast from San Francisco to New York in an illegal cross-country race, with the mob and the police on his tail.

name: Hitman: Blood Money
description: Agent 47 takes contracts across America, staging accidents and slipping through crowds, as a rival agency hunts him and the ICA.

name: Hitman: Absolution
description: Agent 47 goes rogue to protect a girl named Victoria, hiding in plain sight through Chicago and small-town South Dakota with disguises and Instinct.

name: Hitman: Codename 47
description: The debut of Agent 47, a cloned assassin who takes contracts from Hong Kong to Rotterdam and uncovers the truth about his own creation.

name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
description: Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists face off in objective-based matches, planting or defusing bombs and holding or rescuing hostages.

name: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare
description: Call of Duty leaves the Second World War for a modern-day campaign, alongside multiplayer where levelling up unlocks new weapons and attachments.

name: World's Scariest Police Chases
description: An open-world driving game based on the TV show: play a police officer chasing down criminals across the city of Ashland, narrated by John Bunnell.

name: Driver 2
description: Movie-style car chases through Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas and Rio de Janeiro, with Tanner now able to step out and take other cars.

name: Driv3r
description: Undercover agent John Tanner investigates a car-smuggling ring across Miami, Nice and Istanbul, on foot as well as behind the wheel.

name: Galaxy on Fire 2
description: Thrown 35 years into the future by a hyperdrive malfunction, Keith T. Maxwell fights, trades and mines his way across the galaxy as the Void attack.

name: EA Sports FC 24
description: The first EA Sports FC, picking up where the FIFA series left off after FIFA 23.

name: Need for Speed Heat
description: Sanctioned races for cash by day and illicit street racing for rep by night, in the Miami-inspired Palm City.

name: Tell Me Why
description: Telepathic twins Tyler and Alyson reunite in rural Alaska to investigate the death of their mother, each remembering the past differently.

name: Fall Guys
description: Bean-shaped contestants tumble through obstacle courses and survival challenges until one player or team is left to take the win.
